integrity: Original mathematical statement and self-contained proof with reproducible finite tests; finite computations are not substitutes for the all-n proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real-valued paths, strictly positive common variation-edge weights, and increasing sorting only.
The result is an exact two-input seminorm law, not an analogous theorem on cyclic graphs, trees, other gradient powers, or infinite sequences.
Historical novelty remains qualified by possible unindexed equivalent results; independently checked priority is not claimed.
title: Sine-edge weights uniquely minimize the two-input variation instability of finite sorting
